Title: Applied AI Architect, OpenAI for Government
Location: Munich, Germany · London, UK · London · United Kingdom
Description:
About the Team

The OpenAI for Government AI Architect team partners with public sector organizations to turn OpenAI's most capable models into meaningful, real-world impact. We work with government agencies, public institutions, and partner organizations serving the government to identify where AI can advance critical missions, design secure and scalable solutions, and help those solutions move from early exploration into sustained production adoption. The team brings together technical strategy, customer partnership, and practical deployment expertise, working closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Research, Security, Global Affairs, and specialist delivery teams to help public sector customers adopt advanced AI responsibly and effectively.

About the Role

As an AI Architect, you will be the senior technical owner for a named portfolio of customers and the primary technical counterpart to their leadership teams. You will shape each customer's AI strategy and guide their journey from pre-sales discovery and solution evaluation through deployment, adoption, and measurable mission impact.

You will own the technical account plan across ChatGPT Enterprise, the OpenAI API, Codex, and other agentic AI solutions. In partnership with the Account Director, you will translate mission priorities into a focused use-case portfolio, an actionable adoption roadmap, and a clear path to durable customer value. The Account Director leads the overall account strategy and relationship, while you lead the technical strategy, customer journey, and path to production impact.

You will remain accountable for the technical outcome while bringing in the right specialists across deployment, implementation, enablement, security, product, and partners to provide deeper expertise and execute work where needed. This role calls for strong public sector fluency, sound architectural judgment, and the ability to move confidently between executive strategy and hands-on technical conversations.

This role is based in Munich or London. We use a hybrid work model of three days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

- Serve as the primary technical advisor and long-term technical relationship owner for a named portfolio of public sector customers and pre-sales prospects.

- Partner with Account Directors on account strategy while owning the technical account plan, technical milestones, adoption priorities, and expansion opportunities.

- Lead discovery with agency leaders, mission owners, executives, and technical teams to identify, qualify, and prioritize use cases tied to meaningful mission and operational outcomes.

- Develop clear Applied AI Architectures spanning models, applications, data, integration, identity, security, privacy, governance, evaluation, and deployment.

- Guide customers through technical evaluations, demonstrations, workshops, prototypes, and proofs of value, building confidence in both the solution and its path to production.

- Help customers navigate the security, compliance, governance, and deployment requirements that shape AI adoption in the public sector.

- Maintain a focused use-case portfolio with clear decision criteria, ownership, blockers, success measures, delivery needs, and adoption plans.

- Develop trusted relationships and technical champions across CIOs, CTOs, CISOs, Chief Data and AI Officers, program leaders, engineering teams, and other customer stakeholders.

- Qualify and coordinate support from Deployment Engineering, implementation, training and enablement, security, product and domain specialists, partners, and other delivery teams.

- Remain accountable for technical progress and customer outcomes while ensuring delivery teams own implementation execution once engaged.

- Track adoption, usage, account health, production readiness, and measurable mission impact, intervening early when risks threaten value realization.

- Apply public sector and mission expertise to recognize repeatable patterns, sharpen customer priorities, and identify relevant expansion opportunities.

- Share customer insights with Product, Engineering, and Research, translating field learnings into better products, architecture guidance, and reusable practices.

You might thrive in this role if you:

- Have significant experience in customer-facing technical roles such as solutions architecture, solutions engineering, technical account leadership, AI deployment, or technical customer success.

- Have guided complex organizations from technical evaluation through production adoption and measurable impact.

- Have experience working with government agencies, public institutions, or government contractors and understand how mission priorities, security, compliance, governance, and procurement considerations shape technology adoption.

- Build credibility with senior technical and government leaders while communicating equally well with hands-on engineers and program teams.

- Bring strong software and cloud architecture foundations, including APIs, distributed systems, data integration, identity, security, and privacy.

- Understand modern AI systems, frontier models, agentic applications, model evaluation, retrieval, and enterprise AI workflows.

- Can prototype, explain technical tradeoffs, and work confidently with APIs, SDKs, and languages such as Python or JavaScript.

- Exercise sound judgment about when to go deep personally, when to involve specialists, and how to establish clear handoffs and ownership.

- Have experience developing technical account plans, prioritizing complex customer portfolios, and connecting adoption to measurable outcomes.

- Bring meaningful expertise in a relevant public sector mission or customer segment.

- Communicate clearly and can turn ambiguity into a practical technical narrative, executive decision, or action plan.

- Work collaboratively across disciplines and care deeply about helping public sector organizations deploy advanced AI safely and responsibly.

Description:
At Spotify, our Subscriptions Mission focuses on creating experiences that help listeners discover the value of Spotify, become subscribers, and stay with us for the long term. By combining technology, experimentation, and a deep understanding of our users, we help connect artists and fans while building a sustainable subscription business.

Within the Subscriptions Mission, the Subs Foundational Models Product Area is part of the Subs User Understanding Studio. We build scalable machine learning solutions that personalize the subscriber journey, from conversion through to long-term retention. Working closely with teams across the mission, we develop ML solutions that improve key business metrics, including subscriber growth, monthly active users, and Premium retention.

We're looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to join our Radius squad. You'll take ownership of impactful ML initiatives, develop and improve production models, and contribute to the foundational ML capabilities that power personalization and optimization across Subscriptions.

Your work could include reducing friction for Free users while balancing retention and conversion, improving payment experiences to reduce Premium churn, or developing reusable models such as subscriber embeddings that support multiple products and use cases.

- Lead multi-week ML initiatives end to end, from translating business requirements into technical specifications to shipping models and measuring their impact on subscriber metrics

- Own components of our ML systems, making independent technical trade-offs and keeping them observable, reliable, and well documented

- Collaborate with a multi-functional agile team spanning user research, design, data science, product management, and engineering to build new product features that advance our mission to connect artists and fans in personalised and relevant ways

- Prototype new approaches and productionise solutions at scale for our hundreds of millions of active users

- Help drive optimisation, testing, and tooling to improve quality

- Unblock and share context with your teammates to raise the whole squad's velocity

- Use AI-assisted engineering to move faster and remove repetitive toil, while owning the quality of everything you ship

- Partner closely with senior and staff ML engineers, and be part of an active group of machine learning practitioners in your mission and across Spotify

Who You Are

- You have experience building and shipping production ML systems

- You have a strong background in machine learning, theory, and practice

- You are comfortable explaining the intuition and assumptions behind ML concepts

- You can own well-scoped ML projects end to end and make sound technical decisions independently

- You communicate clearly with stakeholders and can explain the reasoning behind your technical choices

- You are curious, open to feedback, and keen to grow your scope over time

- You have hands-on experience implementing and maintaining production ML systems in Python, Scala, or similar languages, including model development with PyTorch

- You are experienced with building data pipelines, and you are self-sufficient in getting the data you need to build and evaluate your models

- You preferably have experience with cloud platforms like GCP or AWS

- You care about agile software processes, data development, reliability, and focused experimentation

- You have a desire to drive business impact

Title: Senior/Lead Machine Learning Engineer
Description:
What we are building
Mimica is an AI-powered process intelligence platform enabling enterprises and individuals to reclaim their most precious resource: time. We've all seen repetitive tasks and redundant processes quietly drain productivity and creativity. Not because companies don’t want to become more efficient, but because they don’t know where to start.
Mimica automatically analyzes your team’s work, then generates the AI agents to execute it. Our software turns everyday work into data-backed decisions, helping companies remove process bottlenecks, automate the right tasks, and upskill teams with precision and confidence.
We’ve raised $26 million in Series B financing and are scaling fast. Backed by investors including Khosla Ventures and Paladin Capital, our proprietary AI technology is trusted by Fortune 500 companies to accelerate transformation. Mimica is recognized as a Top 100 AI Start-up by Accel and an industry Leader by the Everest Group.

Our team
Behind our platform is a team of exceptionally talented people, remote-first and globally distributed across 16+ countries. We're looking for curious, collaborative people excited to solve complex problems. You'll join a fast-paced environment built on high ownership, bottom-up thinking, and transparent, open communication – helping some of the world's leading organizations transform the way work gets done with AI.

Our approach to engineering

- We prioritize customer needs first

- We work in small, project-based teams

- We have flexibility in terms of the problems we work on

- We own the full lifecycle of our projects

- We avoid silos and encourage taking up tasks in new areas

- We balance quality and velocity

- We have a shared responsibility for our production code

- We each set our own routine to maximize our productivity

Your mission
You’ll join us as a Machine Learning Engineer/ Data Scientist for Mimica’s Data Intelligence team, whose goal is to transform raw recorded data into clean, structured, anonymized data that powers the work of other teams.
You’ll own key parts of our ML pipelines end to end, making them more accurate, cost-efficient, and trustworthy. Along the way, you’ll build evaluations and LLM judges, run experiments, and transform promising results into validated production improvements.
Your work will be applied and LLM-heavy, with opportunities to evaluate and fine-tune open-source models and build smaller, task-specific models.
If you enjoy taking ML beyond experiments, this is your chance to shape the systems at the heart of Mimica’s products and see your work deliver value to real users at scale.

Part of your day-to-day

- Own, debug, and improve production pipelines for accuracy and efficiency.

- Design, build, and iterate on LLM evals and LLM-as-a-judge systems, including the datasets, metrics, and benchmarks to monitor quality.

- Run rigorous experiments on prompts, pipeline design, model choice, and inputs (e.g., OCR text vs. image + OCR), and turn the results into clear recommendations.

- Drive LLM efficiency improvements across our pipelines by comparing models, restructuring steps, and replacing LLM calls with smaller, purpose-built models where it makes sense.

- Expand our anonymization pipeline, including evaluating and adapting existing models.

- Work with Python and quality engineers to take experiments into production, and share responsibility for the code you ship.

- Document findings in writing (eg. experiment reports, design docs)

What we’re looking for
Primarily, we’re looking for an individual with an experiment- and data-driven researcher mindset with good coding habits. This includes:

- Solid machine learning/data science background : you understand experimental design, data splits, metrics, bias, and statistical significance, and you know when a result is real.

- Hands-on experience applying LLMs in production or near-production settings , especially evaluating them: building eval sets, LLM judges and benchmarks, and iterating on prompts and pipelines against them.

- Comfortable getting deep into messy data: exploring it, troubleshooting issues, and transforming insights into measurable improvements.

- Strong Python and good engineering skills. You write clear, readable, tested code that others can take to production, even if you’re not the one owning the infrastructure.

- Able to work independently on ambiguous problems: framing the question, choosing the approach, and deciding on the acceptance criteria to ship.

- Use AI coding tools effectively and stay accountable for the output: understand, explain, and defend everything you ship.

- Communicate clearly in spoken and written English, including explaining technical trade-offs to both technical and non-technical audiences

Bonus / Nice to have

- Experience with classical ML or deep learning model development.

- Experience with image/OCR pipelines or face-related anonymization

- Experience shipping end-to-end ML features in a startup or scale-up environment.

Location
This is a fully remote position. To make sure we work well together, we’re only considering candidates based in the UK or Europe , in time zones compatible with London (typically UTC-1 to UTC+3 ).

Hiring Process

- Stage 1. Talent Partner (30-45 min)

- Stage 2. Take-home challenge (flexible) + Technical Discussion with the team (1h)

- Stage 3. Technical design exercise and situational questions in session w/ two ML Engineers (1h)

Description:
About us

At Trainline, our purpose is to empower greener travel choices, connecting people and places. https://www.thetrainline.com/terms/sustainability-faqs Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels.

Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄

We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels.

Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet.

We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel.

Introducing the Trainline MLOps Team 👋

Our MLOps team helps machine learning (ML) and AI teams across Trainline build, launch and run their products reliably. As a Senior MLOps Engineer, you will help shape how we operate AI and ML systems, including the infrastructure and tooling behind our internal ML/AI platforms and our customer-facing products. You will work on systems that are already being built and used across Trainline, so your impact will be real and visible. No two weeks look the same: one day you might be building out our ML platform, the next helping shape the architecture of our multi-agent AI products, and the next improving the developer experience with new tooling and standards. This is a hands-on role with technical leadership at its core. You will join an established team, working alongside our MLOps Engineering Manager and a small group of engineers, as we support a growing number of ML and AI teams. There is genuine scope to influence our technical direction, develop our engineering practices and mentor junior colleagues.

In this role as the Senior MLOps Engineer, you will... 🚅

- Take a leading technical role in helping teams across Trainline adopt and operate ML and AI tooling as the technology evolves

- Support AI infrastructure, working with the teams building our internal platform and customer-facing products, making sure products are well governed, monitored and deployed through automation

- Build and drive adoption of one standard way to deploy ML and AI products, so that new products onboard quickly and reach production faster

- Automate the modernisation of our services across products, including fixing and preventing security vulnerabilities in libraries and dependencies

- Strengthen our MLOps foundations by improving cost tracking, finding ways to reduce costs, addressing security vulnerabilities and standardising engineering practices

- Contribute to technical strategy, evaluating options and making well-reasoned decisions where there is no established approach

- Communicate technical decisions clearly and help prioritise requests from the ML teams we support

- Mentor fellow engineers and share knowledge through documentation and enablement across the organisation

We’d love to hear from you if you have...🔍

- Hands-on experience with IaC and CI/CD tooling, ideally Terraform and GitHub Actions, though alternatives such as AWS CloudFormation and Jenkins are also relevant

- Experience with containerised workloads using Docker and cloud platforms, ideally AWS, though GCP and Azure will be considered

- Experience productionising AI products, including agentic systems and the AIOps tooling behind them, ideally using AWS Bedrock AgentCore or similar

- Experience with managed or self-hosted ML infrastructure, such as Amazon SageMaker, feature stores (e.g. Feast) and DAG tooling (e.g. Airflow, Metaflow, or similar)

- Experience with model experiment tracking, ideally MLflow or Weights & Biases, and with monitoring tools such as EvidentlyAI, CometML, Grafana or New Relic

- Experience writing production-quality, tested Python code

- Experience leading or contributing significantly to major platform changes and migrations, and the ability to lead technical work through ambiguity

- Clear communication, sound prioritisation, and a track record of getting other teams to adopt shared standards and of mentoring colleagues

Nice to have's... 🔑

- Knowledge of cloud topics such as networking fundamentals (VPC, security groups, CDN, WAF, etc.) and identity and access management (IAM, EntraID, SSO, etc.)

- Experience with any of our wider tech stack and partners, including Spacelift, Braintrust and ElevenLabs.

More information:

Enjoy fantastic perks like private healthcare & dental insurance, a generous work from abroad policy, 2-for-1 share purchase plans, an EV Scheme to further reduce carbon emissions, extra festive time off, and excellent family-friendly benefits.

We prioritise career growth with clear career paths, transparent pay bands, personal learning budgets, and regular learning days. Jump on board and supercharge your career from day one!

We're operating a hybrid model and ask that Trainliners work from the office a minimum of 60% of their time over a 12-week period. We also have a 28-day Work from Abroad policy.

- ✔️ Own It - We focus on every customer, partner and journey

- 🤝 Travel Together - We're one team

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
WHY FACULTY?

We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here https://faculty.ai/impact.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Our Energy, Transition and Environment business unit is pioneering meaningful change in the clean energy revolution. Our vision is to accelerate the transition to net-zero emissions and drive efficiencies for a new era of utility companies.

We believe that the responsible, and intelligent, deployment of AI is critical to the success of this mission. We partner with a wide range of clients - from major energy operators, to GreenTech startups, and national infrastructure providers - to build solutions which return measurable impact and move us towards a smarter, cleaner, and more sustainable world.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a Data Scientist II at Faculty, you will lead the design of end-to-end analytical approaches, developing high-quality models that solve complex, multi-faceted business problems. Joining our Applied AI division, you will leverage advanced programming to turn high-level client needs into rigorous mathematical frameworks.

This role is for an ambitious practitioner ready to own the delivery of robust, scalable model components while ensuring every solution is mathematically sound and ethically responsible. You will play a vital part in pushing our technical boundaries and mentoring others.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:

- Designing and implementing core data science approaches for project workstreams, including the selection of optimal algorithms and validation strategies.

- Combining deep domain expertise with advanced machine learning techniques to solve unique and complex business challenges.

- Owning the end-to-end delivery of specific model components, ensuring they are scalable, robust, and mathematically precise.

- Developing innovative algorithms or adapting existing frameworks to meet bespoke client requirements and technical constraints.

- Building the software architecture required to wrap models and agentic workflows into production-grade, reliable environments.

- Supporting Level 1 Data Scientists by providing technical guidance and conducting rigorous peer reviews on modeling tasks.

- Managing personal delivery timelines while proactively identifying and mitigating technical risks or data limitations within projects.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

- You possess expertise in statistical modeling and deep learning frameworks, such as PyTorch or TensorFlow, to implement complex paradigms.

- You are disciplined in extracting valid insights from messy or incomplete datasets, ensuring solutions remain robust under uncertainty.

- You have the ability to translate high-level, ambiguous client needs into actionable data science requirements and mathematical frameworks.

- You promote a culture of shared best practices, ensuring all AI development is transparent, ethical, and held to high peer-reviewed standards.

- You are a clear communicator who can manage technical discussions with customers and articulate project feasibility and delivery timelines.

- You are highly proficient in advanced Python and harness frameworks, capable of building the architectures necessary for production-grade AI.

OUR INTERVIEW PROCESS

1. Talent Team Screen (30 minutes)

2. Take Home Technical Assessment

3. Technical Interview (90 minutes)

4. Commercial Interview (60 minutes)

OUR RECRUITMENT ETHOS

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

Title: AI Engineer
Description:
NetDocuments & PatternBuilder AI Specialist Location: London / Hybrid one day per week in the office
Salary: £90,000 per annum
Contract: Initial six-month fixed-term contract
Reporting to: IT Director
Sector: Legal Technology
The Opportunity We are working with an established law firm to recruit a NetDocuments & PatternBuilder AI Specialist to support the implementation and rollout of AI-enabled solutions across its legal technology environment.
This is a hands-on role for someone with proven experience across both NetDocuments and PatternBuilder, including practical experience with NetDocuments' AI capabilities. You will work closely with the IT Director to help translate business requirements into effective technical solutions, supporting implementation from configuration and testing through to rollout and user adoption.
The firm is looking for someone who understands how legal technology operates in practice and can apply their platform knowledge to real business requirements. Experience working in a law firm or legal-sector technology environment is essential, as is the ability to engage confidently with stakeholders, understand their needs and deliver solutions that work for legal professionals.
This opportunity would suit a technically capable specialist who can take ownership of implementation activities, work independently and collaborate with senior IT leadership and business stakeholders to deliver practical AI and automation solutions.
Key Responsibilities Working closely with the IT Director and relevant stakeholders, you will:

- Implement, configure and roll out AI functionality across NetDocuments and PatternBuilder.
- Build and configure applications, workflows and automation using the relevant platform capabilities.
- Apply hands-on experience with NetDocuments AI products and functionality to support the delivery of AI-enabled solutions.
- Work with stakeholders to understand business requirements and identify opportunities to improve legal workflows through AI and automation.
- Translate user and business requirements into practical technical configurations and working solutions.
- Support the full implementation lifecycle, including requirements gathering, configuration, testing, refinement and deployment.
- Validate solutions before rollout, ensuring they meet requirements and are appropriate for use within a legal environment.
- Engage with legal and business stakeholders to demonstrate functionality, gather feedback and support adoption.
- Work with the IT Director to agree priorities, communicate progress and resolve implementation challenges.
- Consider confidentiality, information security, data protection and appropriate AI governance throughout implementation.
- Produce relevant technical documentation and provide knowledge transfer to support ongoing use and maintenance.
- Liaise with platform vendors and external technology partners where necessary.
Essential Experience and Skills To be considered, you will need to demonstrate:

- Hands-on NetDocuments experience , including practical involvement in configuring, implementing or developing solutions within the platform.
- Hands-on PatternBuilder experience , with the ability to build or configure applications and workflows.
- Specific experience with NetDocuments' AI capabilities or AI products , rather than general AI experience alone.
- Previous experience working in a law firm or legal-sector technology environment.
- Experience implementing and rolling out technology solutions in response to business requirements.
- An understanding of legal workflows, document management and the technology requirements of legal professionals.
- The ability to work independently, take ownership of technical deliverables and progress implementation activities.
- Strong stakeholder-management and communication skills, with the confidence to engage with the IT Director and client-facing business stakeholders.
- The ability to translate business requirements into practical technical solutions and explain these clearly to non-technical users.
- An appreciation of the confidentiality, security and governance considerations associated with AI in a legal environment.
The Person We are looking for a practical, delivery-focused specialist who combines platform expertise with an understanding of how technology is used within a legal environment.
You will be comfortable getting hands-on with NetDocuments and PatternBuilder, configuring solutions, testing functionality and supporting implementation through to rollout. You should be able to work independently while knowing when to involve the IT Director or other stakeholders to resolve issues and agree priorities.
Strong communication skills are important. You will need to understand stakeholder requirements, manage expectations and help ensure the solutions being delivered address genuine business needs.
This is not a generalist AI engineering position. Candidates whose experience is limited to LLM development, generic prompt engineering or AI experimentation, without the required NetDocuments and PatternBuilder experience, will not meet the core requirements.
Working Arrangements
- Salary: £90,000 per annum.
- Contract: Initial six-month fixed-term contract.
- Location: London, with one day per week in the office.
- Reporting line: IT Director.
If you have hands-on experience with NetDocuments, PatternBuilder and NetDocuments AI capabilities, alongside experience delivering technology solutions in the legal sector, we would welcome a conversation.
